Crucially, an independent analytic class-number-formula check (chi via Jacobi/Kronecker, L(1,chi) via digamma/Hurwitz, regulator from CF convergents including half-integer (x+y√D)/2 units) matches all 81 claimed h values to <0.02 after using correct R=log(eps) with minimal half-integer units (e.g. D=85 half-unit (9+√85)/2 explains the naive integer-only discrepancy). Norm signs match minimal-unit search for all 81. No ADMISSION_DEFECT: discriminant normalization (pq=1 mod 4 => disc=pq), tiny instances show both Legendre outcomes, and 2-rank=1 => r4 in {0,1} holds with all h even.

originality.rationale: Live fused search (SerpBase+Serpent+OpenAlex+Crossref, 20 results, full coverage, no partial failure) finds only general theory: Redei-matrix method, Gerth criteria, Fouvry-Kluners/Milovic 4-rank densities, Smith governing fields, LMFDB portal. No source states, tabulates, or implies the exact 13/81 witnessed 4-rank vector for p<q both 1 mod 4, pq<2500 with per-field Redei logs and integer norm/obstruction certificates. Equivalent norm-equation/Hilbert-symbol phrasings, broader density theorems, and LMFDB bare class numbers were explicitly tested and do not cover the claim: densities constrain proportions without computing any finite exact witnessed table, and LMFDB lists at most isolated class numbers without the claimed Redei logs or unramified-extension generator certificates. The work is an independent from-scratch proof, not a database download.

value.rationale: Exact witnessed census of a natural object motivated before computation by the recognized Cohen-Lenstra-Gerth 4-rank program for real quadratics. The all-positive two-prime window (discriminant shape pq, bound 2500) is natural, non-vacuous (both Legendre outcomes and both r4 values occur: 13 rank-1 vs 68 rank-0), and non-constant. Result is not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, or tiny gain: it refutes the naive subtract-1-for-N=+1 reading with 5 proved counterexamples (D=505,905,2005,689,793 with h+=8,h=4,r4=1), gives the correct per-field rho rule, and supplies reusable integer witnesses (5 generator-norms, 8 square-norms, 68 obstructions) calibrating conjectural densities and future 8-rank/governing-field work. A future researcher can reasonably need this precise citable vector. No ADMISSION_DEFECT in value preflight.

perplexity_final_check.rationale: The terminal Perplexity check returned 20 results, of which 2 duplicate the base fused set (the Redei-map general formula and the Qin-type quadratic-extension formula) and 18 are novel URLs. The novel results are general Redei-matrix/4-rank theory restatements, adjacent-family criteria (the q=p+4 diagonal with narrow rank one, the dpq family with d in {-4,-8,8}, imaginary -pq 2-class results, pure-quartic and tame-kernel formulas), governing-field/heuristic discussions, or unrelated D4/elliptic-fibration material. The closest lead, the Hammarhjelm q=p+4 narrow-rank-one subfamily, touches at most two of the 81 window fields and supplies neither the ordinary 13/81 vector with the N=+1 correction nor any witness column, so literal hypothesis/conclusion comparison rules out coverage. No returned source states, tabulates, or substantively implies the exact witnessed 81-field headline; the provisional originality PASS is therefore preserved with no change to correctness or value.
